verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop processor/APU with a local inference software stack. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to agents is a hosted-service account feature, so asking it of a chip is a category error. Nothing in the evidence (the local LLM server interface, the GAIA agent framework, hardware specs) shows any credential-issuance capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
